department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by January 15, 2027 for best funding consideration; the final international deadline is February 2, 2027.
deadline.quote: Preferred deadline (for best consideration for funding): January 15, 2027 | International students (including F-1 and J-1 students currently studying in the United States): February 2, 2027

gre_subject.value: No subject test exists for this field.

gre_general.value: Official GRE scores are required; PhD applicants should have at least 309 with Quant 159. Waivers are rare.
gre_general.quote: Ph.D.: at least 309 with Quantitative section of 159 | Official GRE scores | Waivers are discretionary and uncommon.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to name one or two faculty of interest in the application; no advance agreement is mentioned.

funding.value: RA posts depend on individual faculty funding and TA posts are limited.
funding.quote: Research assistantships may be available from individual faculty members, depending on available resources. | Only a limited number of teaching assistantships are available.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's in engineering, physical sciences, maths or another quantitative field; PhD applicants need a 3.5 GPA.
entry_route.quote: All applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree, typically in engineering, physical sciences, mathematics, or other quantitative fields, from an accredited institution.
